campos.descripcion:
Description
StopWatch is a round AMOLED touch development board designed for portable and interactive scenarios. It features an ESP32-S3R8 main controller with 16MB Flash and 8MB PSRAM, and supports 2.4GHz Wi-Fi wireless communication. The device integrates a 1.75" AMOLED round touch display, programmable buttons, and vibration feedback to provide an intuitive human-machine interaction experience. It also provides audio input/output, IMU attitude sensing, RTC timekeeping, and multiple expansion interfaces. Together with the M5PM1 multi-level power management system and a 450mAh battery, it can meet diverse development needs such as portable smart control, wearable human-machine interaction, and lightweight IoT terminals.
Features
ESP32-S3R8 core controller:
16MB Flash + 8MB PSRAM
2.4GHz Wi-Fi
Interactive experience:
1.75" AMOLED round touch display
2 x programmable buttons, 1 x power button
Built-in vibration motor
6-axis IMU BMI270
Audio system:
ES8311 Audio Codec
MEMS MIC
AW8737A amplifier
RTC clock chip RX8130CE
Expansion capability:
HY2.0-4P expansion interface
Rear expansion bus (2.54-7P, 2.54-6P)
Lanyard hole design
Rear magnetic attachment design
Power system:
M5PM1 multi-level power management system
Built-in 450mAh battery
Balances battery life and low-power operation
Includes
1 x StopWatch
Applications
Portable smart devices
Electronic badges
Lightweight IoT terminals
